verses.numbers 15:35: Numbers 15:35 Then the LORD said to Moses, "The man must surely be put to death; all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside the camp."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 15:36: Numbers 15:36 So, as the LORD commanded Moses, all the congregation brought him outside the camp and stoned him with stones, and he died.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 15:37: Numbers 15:37 Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 15:38: Numbers 15:38 "Speak to the children of Israel: Tell them to make tassels on the corners of their garments throughout their generations, and to put a blue thread in the tassels of the corners.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 15:39: Numbers 15:39 And you shall have the tassel, that you may look upon it and remember all the commandments of the LORD and do them, and that you may not follow the harlotry to which your own heart and your own eyes are inclined,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 15:40: Numbers 15:40 and that you may remember and do all My commandments, and be holy for your God.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 15:41: Numbers 15:41 I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:1: Numbers 16:1 Now Korah the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab, and On the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:2: Numbers 16:2 and they rose up before Moses with some of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty leaders of the congregation, representatives of the congregation, men of renown.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:3: Numbers 16:3 They gathered together against Moses and Aaron, and said to them, "You take too much upon yourselves, for all the congregation is holy, every one of them, and the LORD is among them. Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the LORD?"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:4: Numbers 16:4 So when Moses heard it, he fell on his face;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:5: Numbers 16:5 and he spoke to Korah and all his company, saying, "Tomorrow morning the LORD will show who is His and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to Him. That one whom He chooses He will cause to come near to Him.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:6: Numbers 16:6 Do this: Take censers, Korah and all your company;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:7: Numbers 16:7 put fire in them and put incense in them before the LORD tomorrow, and it shall be that the man whom the LORD chooses is the holy one. You take too much upon yourselves, you sons of Levi!"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:8: Numbers 16:8 Then Moses said to Korah, "Hear now, you sons of Levi:(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:9: Numbers 16:9 Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to Himself, to do the work of the tabernacle of the LORD, and to stand before the congregation to serve them;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:10: Numbers 16:10 and that He has brought you near to Himself, you and all your brethren, the sons of Levi, with you? And are you seeking the priesthood also?(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:11: Numbers 16:11 Therefore you and all your company are gathered together against the LORD. And what is Aaron that you complain against him?"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:12: Numbers 16:12 And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram the sons of Eliab, but they said, "We will not come up!(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:13: Numbers 16:13 Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, that you should keep acting like a prince over us?(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:14: Numbers 16:14 Moreover you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We will not come up!"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:15: Numbers 16:15 Then Moses was very angry, and said to the LORD, "Do not respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, nor have I hurt one of them."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:16: Numbers 16:16 And Moses said to Korah, "Tomorrow, you and all your company be present before the LORD"”you and they, as well as Aaron.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:17: Numbers 16:17 Let each take his censer and put incense in it, and each of you bring his censer before the LORD, two hundred and fifty censers; both you and Aaron, each with his censer."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:18: Numbers 16:18 So every man took his censer, put fire in it, laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the tabernacle of meeting with Moses and Aaron.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:19: Numbers 16:19 And Korah gathered all the congregation against them at the door of the tabernacle of meeting. Then the glory of the LORD appeared to all the congregation.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:20: Numbers 16:20 And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:21: Numbers 16:21 "Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:22: Numbers 16:22 Then they fell on their faces, and said, "O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and You be angry with all the congregation?"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:23: Numbers 16:23 So the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:24: Numbers 16:24 "Speak to the congregation, saying, "˜Get away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.' "(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:25: Numbers 16:25 Then Moses rose and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:26: Numbers 16:26 And he spoke to the congregation, saying, "Depart now from the tents of these wicked men! Touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:27: Numbers 16:27 So they got away from around the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram; and Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the door of their tents, with their wives, their sons, and their little children.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:28: Numbers 16:28 And Moses said: "By this you shall know that the LORD has sent me to do all these works, for I have not done them of my own will.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:29: Numbers 16:29 If these men die naturally like all men, or if they are visited by the common fate of all men, then the LORD has not sent me.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:30: Numbers 16:30 But if the LORD creates a new thing, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them up with all that belongs to them, and they go down alive into the pit, then you will understand that these men have rejected the LORD."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:31: Numbers 16:31 Now it came to pass, as he finished speaking all these words, that the ground split apart under them,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:32: Numbers 16:32 and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households and all the men with Korah, with all their goods.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:33: Numbers 16:33 So they and all those with them went down alive into the pit; the earth closed over them, and they perished from among the assembly.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:34: Numbers 16:34 Then all Israel who were around them fled at their cry, for they said, "Lest the earth swallow us up also!"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:35: Numbers 16:35 And a fire came out from the LORD and consumed the two hundred and fifty men who were offering incense.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:36: Numbers 16:36 Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:37: Numbers 16:37 "Tell Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, to pick up the censers out of the blaze, for they are holy, and scatter the fire some distance away.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:38: Numbers 16:38 The censers of these men who sinned against their own souls, let them be made into hammered plates as a covering for the altar. Because they presented them before the LORD, therefore they are holy; and they shall be a sign to the children of Israel."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:39: Numbers 16:39 So Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers, which those who were burned up had presented, and they were hammered out as a covering on the altar,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:40: Numbers 16:40 to be a memorial to the children of Israel that no outsider, who is not a descendant of Aaron, should come near to offer incense before the LORD, that he might not become like Korah and his companions, just as the LORD had said to him through Moses.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:41: Numbers 16:41 On the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and Aaron, saying, "You have killed the people of the LORD."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:42: Numbers 16:42 Now it happened, when the congregation had gathered against Moses and Aaron, that they turned toward the tabernacle of meeting; and suddenly the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:43: Numbers 16:43 Then Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of meeting.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:44: Numbers 16:44 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:45: Numbers 16:45 "Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment." And they fell on their faces.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:46: Numbers 16:46 So Moses said to Aaron, "Take a censer and put fire in it from the altar, put incense on it, and take it quickly to the congregation and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from the LORD. The plague has begun."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:47: Numbers 16:47 Then Aaron took it as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the assembly; and already the plague had begun among the people. So he put in the incense and made atonement for the people.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:48: Numbers 16:48 And he stood between the dead and the living; so the plague was stopped.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:49: Numbers 16:49 Now those who died in the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, besides those who died in the Korah incident.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 16:50: Numbers 16:50 So Aaron returned to Moses at the door of the tabernacle of meeting, for the plague had stopped.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 17:1: Numbers 17:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:(NKJV)
verses.numbers 17:2: Numbers 17:2 "Speak to the children of Israel, and get from them a rod from each father's house, all their leaders according to their fathers' houses"”twelve rods. Write each man's name on his rod.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 17:3: Numbers 17:3 And you shall write Aaron's name on the rod of Levi. For there shall be one rod for the head of each father's house.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 17:4: Numbers 17:4 Then you shall place them in the tabernacle of meeting before the Testimony, where I meet with you.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 17:5: Numbers 17:5 And it shall be that the rod of the man whom I choose will blossom; thus I will rid Myself of the complaints of the children of Israel, which they make against you."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 17:6: Numbers 17:6 So Moses spoke to the children of Israel, and each of their leaders gave him a rod apiece, for each leader according to their fathers' houses, twelve rods; and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 17:7: Numbers 17:7 And Moses placed the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 17:8: Numbers 17:8 Now it came to pass on the next day that Moses went into the tabernacle of witness, and behold, the rod of Aaron, of the house of Levi, had sprouted and put forth buds, had produced blossoms and yielded ripe almonds.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 17:9: Numbers 17:9 Then Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD to all the children of Israel; and they looked, and each man took his rod.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 17:10: Numbers 17:10 And the LORD said to Moses, "Bring Aaron's rod back before the Testimony, to be kept as a sign against the rebels, that you may put their complaints away from Me, lest they die."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 17:11: Numbers 17:11 Thus did Moses; just as the LORD had commanded him, so he did.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 17:12: Numbers 17:12 So the children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, "Surely we die, we perish, we all perish!(NKJV)
verses.numbers 17:13: Numbers 17:13 Whoever even comes near the tabernacle of the LORD must die. Shall we all utterly die?"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:1: Numbers 18:1 Then the LORD said to Aaron: "You and your sons and your father's house with you shall bear the iniquity related to the sanctuary, and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity associated with your priesthood.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:2: Numbers 18:2 Also bring with you your brethren of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, that they may be joined with you and serve you while you and your sons are with you before the tabernacle of witness.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:3: Numbers 18:3 They shall attend to your needs and all the needs of the tabernacle; but they shall not come near the articles of the sanctuary and the altar, lest they die"”they and you also.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:4: Numbers 18:4 They shall be joined with you and attend to the needs of the tabernacle of meeting, for all the work of the tabernacle; but an outsider shall not come near you.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:5: Numbers 18:5 And you shall attend to the duties of the sanctuary and the duties of the altar, that there may be no more wrath on the children of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:6: Numbers 18:6 Behold, I Myself have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel; they are a gift to you, given by the LORD, to do the work of the tabernacle of meeting.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:7: Numbers 18:7 Therefore you and your sons with you shall attend to your priesthood for everything at the altar and behind the veil; and you shall serve. I give your priesthood to you as a gift for service, but the outsider who comes near shall be put to death."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:8: Numbers 18:8 And the LORD spoke to Aaron: "Here, I Myself have also given you charge of My heave offerings, all the holy gifts of the children of Israel; I have given them as a portion to you and your sons, as an ordinance forever.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:9: Numbers 18:9 This shall be yours of the most holy things reserved from the fire: every offering of theirs, every grain offering and every sin offering and every trespass offering which they render to Me, shall be most holy for you and your sons.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:10: Numbers 18:10 In a most holy place you shall eat it; every male shall eat it. It shall be holy to you.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:11: Numbers 18:11 "This also is yours: the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel; I have given them to you, and your sons and daughters with you, as an ordinance forever. Everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:12: Numbers 18:12 "All the best of the oil, all the best of the new wine and the grain, their firstfruits which they offer to the LORD, I have given them to you.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:13: Numbers 18:13 Whatever first ripe fruit is in their land, which they bring to the LORD, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:14: Numbers 18:14 "Every devoted thing in Israel shall be yours.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:15: Numbers 18:15 "Everything that first opens the womb of all flesh, which they bring to the LORD, whether man or beast, shall be yours; nevertheless the firstborn of man you shall surely redeem, and the firstborn of unclean animals you shall redeem.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:16: Numbers 18:16 And those redeemed of the devoted things you shall redeem when one month old, according to your valuation, for five shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:17: Numbers 18:17 But the firstborn of a cow, the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat you shall not redeem; they are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and burn their fat as an offering made by fire for a sweet aroma to the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:18: Numbers 18:18 And their flesh shall be yours, just as the wave breast and the right thigh are yours.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:19: Numbers 18:19 "All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer to the LORD, I have given to you and your sons and daughters with you as an ordinance forever; it is a covenant of salt forever before the LORD with you and your descendants with you."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:20: Numbers 18:20 Then the LORD said to Aaron: "You shall have no inheritance in their land, nor shall you have any portion among them; I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:21: Numbers 18:21 "Behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tithes in Israel as an inheritance in return for the work which they perform, the work of the tabernacle of meeting.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:22: Numbers 18:22 Hereafter the children of Israel shall not come near the tabernacle of meeting, lest they bear sin and die.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:23: Numbers 18:23 But the Levites shall perform the work of the tabernacle of meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity; it shall be a statute forever, throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:24: Numbers 18:24 For the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer up as a heave offering to the LORD, I have given to the Levites as an inheritance; therefore I have said to them, "˜Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.' "(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:25: Numbers 18:25 Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:26: Numbers 18:26 "Speak thus to the Levites, and say to them: "˜When you take from the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them as your inheritance, then you shall offer up a heave offering of it to the LORD, a tenth of the tithe.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:27: Numbers 18:27 And your heave offering shall be reckoned to you as though it were the grain of the threshing floor and as the fullness of the winepress.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:28: Numbers 18:28 Thus you shall also offer a heave offering to the LORD from all your tithes which you receive from the children of Israel, and you shall give the LORD's heave offering from it to Aaron the priest.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:29: Numbers 18:29 Of all your gifts you shall offer up every heave offering due to the LORD, from all the best of them, the consecrated part of them.'(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:30: Numbers 18:30 Therefore you shall say to them: "˜When you have lifted up the best of it, then the rest shall be accounted to the Levites as the produce of the threshing floor and as the produce of the winepress.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:31: Numbers 18:31 You may eat it in any place, you and your households, for it is your reward for your work in the tabernacle of meeting.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 18:32: Numbers 18:32 And you shall bear no sin because of it, when you have lifted up the best of it. But you shall not profane the holy gifts of the children of Israel, lest you die.' "(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:1: Numbers 19:1 Now the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:2: Numbers 19:2 "This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD has commanded, saying: "˜Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring you a red heifer without blemish, in which there is no defect and on which a yoke has never come.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:3: Numbers 19:3 You shall give it to Eleazar the priest, that he may take it outside the camp, and it shall be slaughtered before him;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:4: Numbers 19:4 and Eleazar the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and sprinkle some of its blood seven times directly in front of the tabernacle of meeting.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:5: Numbers 19:5 Then the heifer shall be burned in his sight: its hide, its flesh, its blood, and its offal shall be burned.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:6: Numbers 19:6 And the priest shall take cedar wood and hyssop and scarlet, and cast them into the midst of the fire burning the heifer.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:7: Numbers 19:7 Then the priest shall wash his clothes, he shall bathe in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp; the priest shall be unclean until evening.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:8: Numbers 19:8 And the one who burns it shall wash his clothes in water, bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:9: Numbers 19:9 Then a man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and store them outside the camp in a clean place; and they shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for the water of purification; it is for purifying from sin.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:10: Numbers 19:10 And the one who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until evening. It shall be a statute forever to the children of Israel and to the stranger who dwells among them.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:11: Numbers 19:11 "˜He who touches the dead body of anyone shall be unclean seven days.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:12: Numbers 19:12 He shall purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then he will be clean. But if he does not purify himself on the third day and on the seventh day, he will not be clean.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:13: Numbers 19:13 Whoever touches the body of anyone who has died, and does not purify himself, defiles the tabernacle of the LORD. That person shall be cut off from Israel. He shall be unclean, because the water of purification was not sprinkled on him; his uncleanness is still on him.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:14: Numbers 19:14 "˜This is the law when a man dies in a tent: All who come into the tent and all who are in the tent shall be unclean seven days;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:15: Numbers 19:15 and every open vessel, which has no cover fastened on it, is unclean.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:16: Numbers 19:16 Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain by a sword or who has died, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:17: Numbers 19:17 "˜And for an unclean person they shall take some of the ashes of the heifer burnt for purification from sin, and running water shall be put on them in a vessel.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:18: Numbers 19:18 A clean person shall take hyssop and dip it in the water, sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, or on the one who touched a bone, the slain, the dead, or a grave.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:19: Numbers 19:19 The clean person shall sprinkle the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day; and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, wash his clothes, and bathe in water; and at evening he shall be clean.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:20: Numbers 19:20 "˜But the man who is unclean and does not purify himself, that person shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water of purification has not been sprinkled on him; he is unclean.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:21: Numbers 19:21 It shall be a perpetual statute for them. He who sprinkles the water of purification shall wash his clothes; and he who touches the water of purification shall be unclean until evening.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 19:22: Numbers 19:22 Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the person who touches it shall be unclean until evening.' "(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:1: Numbers 20:1 Then  the children of Israel, the whole congregation, came into the Wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people stayed in Kadesh; and Miriam died there and was buried there.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:2: Numbers 20:2 Now there was no water for the congregation; so they gathered together against Moses and Aaron.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:3: Numbers 20:3 And the people contended with Moses and spoke, saying: "If only we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:4: Numbers 20:4 Why have you brought up the assembly of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our animals should die here?(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:5: Numbers 20:5 And why have you made us come up out of Egypt, to bring us to this evil place? It is not a place of grain or figs or vines or pomegranates; nor is there any water to drink."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:6: Numbers 20:6 So Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and they fell on their faces. And the glory of the LORD appeared to them.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:7: Numbers 20:7 Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:8: Numbers 20:8 "Take the rod; you and your brother Aaron gather the congregation together. Speak to the rock before their eyes, and it will yield its water; thus you shall bring water for them out of the rock, and give drink to the congregation and their animals."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:9: Numbers 20:9 So Moses took the rod from before the LORD as He commanded him.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:10: Numbers 20:10 And Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock; and he said to them, "Hear now, you rebels! Must we bring water for you out of this rock?"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:11: Numbers 20:11 Then Moses lifted his hand and struck the rock twice with his rod; and water came out abundantly, and the congregation and their animals drank.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:12: Numbers 20:12 Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, "Because you did not believe Me, to hallow Me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:13: Numbers 20:13 This was the water of Meribah, because the children of Israel contended with the LORD, and He was hallowed among them.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:14: Numbers 20:14 Now Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom. "Thus says your brother Israel: "˜You know all the hardship that has befallen us,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:15: Numbers 20:15 how our fathers went down to Egypt, and we dwelt in Egypt a long time, and the Egyptians afflicted us and our fathers.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:16: Numbers 20:16 When we cried out to the LORD, He heard our voice and sent the Angel and brought us up out of Egypt; now here we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of your border.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:17: Numbers 20:17 Please let us pass through your country. We will not pass through fields or vineyards, nor will we drink water from wells; we will go along the King's Highway; we will not turn aside to the right hand or to the left until we have passed through your territory.' "(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:18: Numbers 20:18 Then Edom said to him, "You shall not pass through my land, lest I come out against you with the sword."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:19: Numbers 20:19 So the children of Israel said to him, "We will go by the Highway, and if I or my livestock drink any of your water, then I will pay for it; let me only pass through on foot, nothing more."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:20: Numbers 20:20 Then he said, "You shall not pass through." So Edom came out against them with many men and with a strong hand.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:21: Numbers 20:21 Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his territory; so Israel turned away from him.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:22: Numbers 20:22 Now the children of Israel, the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh and came to Mount Hor.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:23: Numbers 20:23 And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor by the border of the land of Edom, saying:(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:24: Numbers 20:24 "Aaron shall be gathered to his people, for he shall not enter the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against My word at the water of Meribah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:25: Numbers 20:25 Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:26: Numbers 20:26 and strip Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son; for Aaron shall be gathered to his people and die there."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:27: Numbers 20:27 So Moses did just as the LORD commanded, and they went up to Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:28: Numbers 20:28 Moses stripped Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there on the top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 20:29: Numbers 20:29 Now when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, all the house of Israel mourned for Aaron thirty days.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:1: Numbers 21:1 The king of Arad, the Canaanite, who dwelt in the South, heard that Israel was coming on the road to Atharim. Then he fought against Israel and took some of them prisoners.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:2: Numbers 21:2 So Israel made a vow to the LORD, and said, "If You will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:3: Numbers 21:3 And the LORD listened to the voice of Israel and delivered up the Canaanites, and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. So the name of that place was called Hormah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:4: Numbers 21:4 Then they journeyed from Mount Hor by the Way of the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom; and the soul of the people became very discouraged on the way.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:5: Numbers 21:5 And the people spoke against God and against Moses: "Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no food and no water, and our soul loathes this worthless bread."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:6: Numbers 21:6 So the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and many of the people of Israel died.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:7: Numbers 21:7 Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, "We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD and against you; pray to the LORD that He take away the serpents from us." So Moses prayed for the people.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:8: Numbers 21:8 Then the LORD said to Moses, "Make a fiery serpent, and set it on a pole; and it shall be that everyone who is bitten, when he looks at it, shall live."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:9: Numbers 21:9 So Moses made a bronze serpent, and put it on a pole; and so it was, if a serpent had bitten anyone, when he looked at the bronze serpent, he lived.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:10: Numbers 21:10 Now the children of Israel moved on and camped in Oboth.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:11: Numbers 21:11 And they journeyed from Oboth and camped at Ije Abarim, in the wilderness which is east of Moab, toward the sunrise.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:12: Numbers 21:12 From there they moved and camped in the Valley of Zered.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:13: Numbers 21:13 From there they moved and camped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that extends from the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:14: Numbers 21:14 Therefore it is said in the Book of the Wars of the LORD: "Waheb in Suphah, The brooks of the Arnon,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:15: Numbers 21:15 And the slope of the brooks That reaches to the dwelling of Ar, And lies on the border of Moab."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:16: Numbers 21:16 From there they went to Beer, which is the well where the LORD said to Moses, "Gather the people together, and I will give them water."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:17: Numbers 21:17 Then Israel sang this song:  "Spring up, O well! All of you sing to it"”(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:18: Numbers 21:18 The well the leaders sank, Dug by the nation's nobles, By the lawgiver, with their staves."  And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:19: Numbers 21:19 from Mattanah to Nahaliel, from Nahaliel to Bamoth,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:20: Numbers 21:20 and from Bamoth, in the valley that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah which looks down on the wasteland.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:21: Numbers 21:21 Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:22: Numbers 21:22 "Let me pass through your land. We will not turn aside into fields or vineyards; we will not drink water from wells. We will go by the King's Highway until we have passed through your territory."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:23: Numbers 21:23 But Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his territory. So Sihon gathered all his people together and went out against Israel in the wilderness, and he came to Jahaz and fought against Israel.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:24: Numbers 21:24 Then Israel defeated him with the edge of the sword, and took possession of his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as the people of Ammon; for the border of the people of Ammon was fortified.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:25: Numbers 21:25 So Israel took all these cities, and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon and in all its villages.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:26: Numbers 21:26 For Heshbon was the city of Sihon king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and had taken all his land from his hand as far as the Arnon.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:27: Numbers 21:27 Therefore those who speak in proverbs say: "Come to Heshbon, let it be built; Let the city of Sihon be repaired.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:28: Numbers 21:28 "For fire went out from Heshbon, A flame from the city of Sihon; It consumed Ar of Moab, The lords of the heights of the Arnon.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:29: Numbers 21:29 Woe to you, Moab! You have perished, O people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, And his daughters into captivity, To Sihon king of the Amorites.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:30: Numbers 21:30 "But we have shot at them; Heshbon has perished as far as Dibon. Then we laid waste as far as Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:31: Numbers 21:31 Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:32: Numbers 21:32 Then Moses sent to spy out Jazer; and they took its villages and drove out the Amorites who were there.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:33: Numbers 21:33 And they turned and went up by the way to Bashan. So Og king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:34: Numbers 21:34 Then the LORD said to Moses, "Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people and his land; and you shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 21:35: Numbers 21:35 So they defeated him, his sons, and all his people, until there was no survivor left him; and they took possession of his land.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:1: Numbers 22:1 Then the children of Israel moved, and camped in the plains of Moab on the side of the Jordan across from Jericho.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:2: Numbers 22:2 Now Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:3: Numbers 22:3 And Moab was exceedingly afraid of the people because they were many, and Moab was sick with dread because of the children of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:4: Numbers 22:4 So Moab said to the elders of Midian, "Now this company will lick up everything around us, as an ox licks up the grass of the field." And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:5: Numbers 22:5 Then he sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor at Pethor, which is near the River in the land of the sons of his people, to call him, saying: "Look, a people has come from Egypt. See, they cover the face of the earth, and are settling next to me!(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:6: Numbers 22:6 Therefore please come at once, curse this people for me, for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall be able to defeat them and drive them out of the land, for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:7: Numbers 22:7 So the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the diviner's fee in their hand, and they came to Balaam and spoke to him the words of Balak.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:8: Numbers 22:8 And he said to them, "Lodge here tonight, and I will bring back word to you, as the LORD speaks to me." So the princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:9: Numbers 22:9 Then God came to Balaam and said, "Who are these men with you?"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:10: Numbers 22:10 So Balaam said to God, "Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent to me, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:11: Numbers 22:11 "˜Look, a people has come out of Egypt, and they cover the face of the earth. Come now, curse them for me; perhaps I shall be able to overpower them and drive them out.' "(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:12: Numbers 22:12 And God said to Balaam, "You shall not go with them; you shall not curse the people, for they are blessed."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:13: Numbers 22:13 So Balaam rose in the morning and said to the princes of Balak, "Go back to your land, for the LORD has refused to give me permission to go with you."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:14: Numbers 22:14 And the princes of Moab rose and went to Balak, and said, "Balaam refuses to come with us."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:15: Numbers 22:15 Then Balak again sent princes, more numerous and more honorable than they.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:16: Numbers 22:16 And they came to Balaam and said to him, "Thus says Balak the son of Zippor: "˜Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:17: Numbers 22:17 for I will certainly honor you greatly, and I will do whatever you say to me. Therefore please come, curse this people for me.' "(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:18: Numbers 22:18 Then Balaam answered and said to the servants of Balak, "Though Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:19: Numbers 22:19 Now therefore, please, you also stay here tonight, that I may know what more the LORD will say to me."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:20: Numbers 22:20 And God came to Balaam at night and said to him, "If the men come to call you, rise and go with them; but only the word which I speak to you"”that you shall do."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:21: Numbers 22:21 So Balaam rose in the morning, saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:22: Numbers 22:22 Then God's anger was aroused because he went, and the Angel of the LORD took His stand in the way as an adversary against him. And he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:23: Numbers 22:23 Now the donkey saw the Angel of the LORD standing in the way with His drawn sword in His hand, and the donkey turned aside out of the way and went into the field. So Balaam struck the donkey to turn her back onto the road.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:24: Numbers 22:24 Then the Angel of the LORD stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, with a wall on this side and a wall on that side.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:25: Numbers 22:25 And when the donkey saw the Angel of the LORD, she pushed herself against the wall and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall; so he struck her again.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:26: Numbers 22:26 Then the Angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:27: Numbers 22:27 And when the donkey saw the Angel of the LORD, she lay down under Balaam; so Balaam's anger was aroused, and he struck the donkey with his staff.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:28: Numbers 22:28 Then the LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, "What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 22:29: Numbers 22:29 And Balaam said to the donkey, "Because you have abused me. I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would kill you!"(NKJV)

verses.numbers 22:31: Numbers 22:31 Then the LORD opened Balaam's eyes, and he saw the Angel of the LORD standing in the way with His drawn sword in His hand; and he bowed his head and fell flat on his face.(NKJV)

verses.numbers 22:40: Numbers 22:40 Then Balak offered oxen and sheep, and he sent some to Balaam and to the princes who were with him.(NKJV)

verses.numbers 23:1: Numbers 23:1 Then Balaam said to Balak, "Build seven altars for me here, and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:2: Numbers 23:2 And Balak did just as Balaam had spoken, and Balak and Balaam offered a bull and a ram on each altar.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:3: Numbers 23:3 Then Balaam said to Balak, "Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go; perhaps the LORD will come to meet me, and whatever He shows me I will tell you." So he went to a desolate height.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:4: Numbers 23:4 And God met Balaam, and he said to Him, "I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered on each altar a bull and a ram."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:5: Numbers 23:5 Then the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, "Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:6: Numbers 23:6 So he returned to him, and there he was, standing by his burnt offering, he and all the princes of Moab.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:7: Numbers 23:7 And he took up his oracle and said: "Balak the king of Moab has brought me from Aram, From the mountains of the east.  "˜Come, curse Jacob for me, And come, denounce Israel!'(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:8: Numbers 23:8 "How  shall I curse whom God has not cursed? And how shall I denounce whom the LORD has not denounced?(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:9: Numbers 23:9 For from the top of the rocks I see him, And from the hills I behold him; There! A people dwelling alone,  Not reckoning itself among the nations.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:10: Numbers 23:10 "Who  can count the dust of Jacob, Or number one-fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, And let my end be like his!"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:11: Numbers 23:11 Then Balak said to Balaam, "What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and look, you have blessed them bountifully!"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:12: Numbers 23:12 So he answered and said, "Must I not take heed to speak what the LORD has put in my mouth?"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:13: Numbers 23:13 Then Balak said to him, "Please come with me to another place from which you may see them; you shall see only the outer part of them, and shall not see them all; curse them for me from there."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:14: Numbers 23:14 So he brought him to the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:15: Numbers 23:15 And he said to Balak, "Stand here by your burnt offering while I meet the LORD over there."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:16: Numbers 23:16 Then the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, "Go back to Balak, and thus you shall speak."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:17: Numbers 23:17 So he came to him, and there he was, standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab were with him. And Balak said to him, "What has the LORD spoken?"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:18: Numbers 23:18 Then he took up his oracle and said:  "Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, son of Zippor!(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:19: Numbers 23:19 "God  is not a man, that He should lie, Nor a son of man, that He should repent. Has He said, and will He not do? Or has He spoken, and will He not make it good?(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:20: Numbers 23:20 Behold, I have received a command to bless;  He has blessed, and I cannot reverse it.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:21: Numbers 23:21 "He  has not observed iniquity in Jacob, Nor has He seen wickedness in Israel. The LORD his God is with him,  And the shout of a King is among them.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:22: Numbers 23:22 God brings them out of Egypt; He has strength like a wild ox.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:23: Numbers 23:23 "For there is no sorcery against Jacob, Nor any divination against Israel. It now must be said of Jacob And of Israel, "˜Oh, what God has done!'(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:24: Numbers 23:24 Look, a people rises like a lioness, And lifts itself up like a lion;  It shall not lie down until it devours the prey, And drinks the blood of the slain."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:25: Numbers 23:25 Then Balak said to Balaam, "Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all!"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:26: Numbers 23:26 So Balaam answered and said to Balak, "Did I not tell you, saying, "˜All that the LORD speaks, that I must do'?"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:27: Numbers 23:27 Then Balak said to Balaam, "Please come, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:28: Numbers 23:28 So Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that overlooks the wasteland.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:29: Numbers 23:29 Then Balaam said to Balak, "Build for me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 23:30: Numbers 23:30 And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on every altar.(NKJV)

verses.numbers 24:5: Numbers 24:5 "How lovely are your tents, O Jacob! Your dwellings, O Israel!(NKJV)

verses.numbers 24:10: Numbers 24:10 Then Balak's anger was aroused against Balaam, and he struck his hands together; and Balak said to Balaam, "I called you to curse my enemies, and look, you have bountifully blessed them these three times!(NKJV)

verses.numbers 24:17: Numbers 24:17 "I  see Him, but not now; I behold Him, but not near;  A Star shall come out of Jacob;  A Scepter shall rise out of Israel, And batter the brow of Moab, And destroy all the sons of tumult.(NKJV)

verses.numbers 24:22: Numbers 24:22 Nevertheless Kain shall be burned. How long until Asshur carries you away captive?"(NKJV)
verses.numbers 24:23: Numbers 24:23 Then he took up his oracle and said: "Alas! Who shall live when God does this?(NKJV)
verses.numbers 24:24: Numbers 24:24 But ships shall come from the coasts of Cyprus, And they shall afflict Asshur and afflict Eber, And so shall Amalek, until he perishes."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 24:25: Numbers 24:25 So Balaam rose and departed and returned to his place; Balak also went his way.(NKJV)

verses.numbers 27:9: Numbers 27:9 If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.(NKJV)

verses.numbers 27:12: Numbers 27:12 Now the LORD said to Moses: "Go up into this Mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 27:13: Numbers 27:13 And when you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered.(NKJV)

verses.numbers 27:15: Numbers 27:15 Then Moses spoke to the LORD, saying:(NKJV)
verses.numbers 27:16: Numbers 27:16 "Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 27:17: Numbers 27:17 who may go out before them and go in before them, who may lead them out and bring them in, that the congregation of the LORD may not be like sheep which have no shepherd."(NKJV)
