verses.numbers 27:19: Numbers 27:19 set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation, and inaugurate him in their sight.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 27:20: Numbers 27:20 And you shall give some of your authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 27:21: Numbers 27:21 He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire before the LORD for him by the judgment of the Urim. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, he and all the children of Israel with him"”all the congregation."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 27:22: Numbers 27:22 So Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 27:23: Numbers 27:23 And he laid his hands on him and inaugurated him, just as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:1: Numbers 28:1 Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:2: Numbers 28:2 "Command the children of Israel, and say to them, "˜My offering, My food for My offerings made by fire as a sweet aroma to Me, you shall be careful to offer to Me at their appointed time.'(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:3: Numbers 28:3 "And you shall say to them, "˜This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: two male lambs in their first year without blemish, day by day, as a regular burnt offering.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:4: Numbers 28:4 The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, the other lamb you shall offer in the evening,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:5: Numbers 28:5 and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with one-fourth of a hin of pressed oil.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:6: Numbers 28:6 It is a regular burnt offering which was ordained at Mount Sinai for a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:7: Numbers 28:7 And its drink offering shall be one-fourth of a hin for each lamb; in a holy place you shall pour out the drink to the LORD as an offering.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:8: Numbers 28:8 The other lamb you shall offer in the evening; as the morning grain offering and its drink offering, you shall offer it as an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:9: Numbers 28:9 "˜And on the Sabbath day two lambs in their first year, without blemish, and two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, with its drink offering"”(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:10: Numbers 28:10 this is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:11: Numbers 28:11 "˜At the beginnings of your months you shall present a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year, without blemish;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:12: Numbers 28:12 three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:13: Numbers 28:13 and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with oil, as a grain offering for each lamb, as a burnt offering of sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:14: Numbers 28:14 Their drink offering shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, one-third of a hin for a ram, and one-fourth of a hin for a lamb; this is the burnt offering for each month throughout the months of the year.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:15: Numbers 28:15 Also one kid of the goats as a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered, besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:16: Numbers 28:16 "˜On the fourteenth day of the first month is the Passover of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:17: Numbers 28:17 And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast; unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:18: Numbers 28:18 On the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:19: Numbers 28:19 And you shall present an offering made by fire as a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year. Be sure they are without blemish.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:20: Numbers 28:20 Their grain offering shall be of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah you shall offer for a bull, and two-tenths for a ram;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:21: Numbers 28:21 you shall offer one-tenth of an ephah for each of the seven lambs;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:22: Numbers 28:22 also one goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:23: Numbers 28:23 You shall offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a regular burnt offering.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:24: Numbers 28:24 In this manner you shall offer the food of the offering made by fire daily for seven days, as a sweet aroma to the LORD; it shall be offered besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:25: Numbers 28:25 And on the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:26: Numbers 28:26 "˜Also on the day of the firstfruits, when you bring a new grain offering to the LORD at your Feast of Weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:27: Numbers 28:27 You shall present a burnt offering as a sweet aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:28: Numbers 28:28 with their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for each bull, two-tenths for the one ram,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:29: Numbers 28:29 and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:30: Numbers 28:30 also one kid of the goats, to make atonement for you.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 28:31: Numbers 28:31 Be sure they are without blemish. You shall present them with their drink offerings, besides the regular burnt offering with its grain offering.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:1: Numbers 29:1 "˜And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work. For you it is a day of blowing the trumpets.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:2: Numbers 29:2 You shall offer a burnt offering as a sweet aroma to the LORD: one young bull, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year, without blemish.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:3: Numbers 29:3 Their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull, two-tenths for the ram,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:4: Numbers 29:4 and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:5: Numbers 29:5 also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, to make atonement for you;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:6: Numbers 29:6 besides the burnt offering with its grain offering for the New Moon, the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, as a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:7: Numbers 29:7 "˜On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls; you shall not do any work.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:8: Numbers 29:8 You shall present a burnt offering to the LORD as a sweet aroma: one young bull, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year. Be sure they are without blemish.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:9: Numbers 29:9 Their grain offering shall be of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull, two-tenths for the one ram,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:10: Numbers 29:10 and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:11: Numbers 29:11 also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, besides the sin offering for atonement, the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:12: Numbers 29:12 "˜On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no customary work, and you shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:13: Numbers 29:13 You shall present a burnt offering, an offering made by fire as a sweet aroma to the LORD: thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs in their first year. They shall be without blemish.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:14: Numbers 29:14 Their grain offering shall be of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for each of the thirteen bulls, two-tenths for each of the two rams,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:15: Numbers 29:15 and one-tenth for each of the fourteen lambs;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:16: Numbers 29:16 also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:17: Numbers 29:17 "˜On the second day present twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs in their first year without blemish,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:18: Numbers 29:18 and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:19: Numbers 29:19 also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:20: Numbers 29:20 "˜On the third day present eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs in their first year without blemish,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:21: Numbers 29:21 and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:22: Numbers 29:22 also one goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:23: Numbers 29:23 "˜On the fourth day present ten bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs in their first year, without blemish,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:24: Numbers 29:24 and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:25: Numbers 29:25 also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:26: Numbers 29:26 "˜On the fifth day present nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs in their first year without blemish,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:27: Numbers 29:27 and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:28: Numbers 29:28 also one goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:29: Numbers 29:29 "˜On the sixth day present eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs in their first year without blemish,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:30: Numbers 29:30 and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:31: Numbers 29:31 also one goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:32: Numbers 29:32 "˜On the seventh day present seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs in their first year without blemish,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:33: Numbers 29:33 and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:34: Numbers 29:34 also one goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:35: Numbers 29:35 "˜On the eighth day you shall have a sacred assembly. You shall do no customary work.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:36: Numbers 29:36 You shall present a burnt offering, an offering made by fire as a sweet aroma to the LORD: one bull, one ram, seven lambs in their first year without blemish,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:37: Numbers 29:37 and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:38: Numbers 29:38 also one goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:39: Numbers 29:39 "˜These you shall present to the LORD at your appointed feasts (besides your vowed offerings and your freewill offerings) as your burnt offerings and your grain offerings, as your drink offerings and your peace offerings.' "(NKJV)
verses.numbers 29:40: Numbers 29:40 So Moses told the children of Israel everything, just as the LORD commanded Moses.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:1: Numbers 30:1 Then Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, "This is the thing which the LORD has commanded:(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:2: Numbers 30:2 If a man makes a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind himself by some agreement, he shall not break his word; he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:3: Numbers 30:3 "Or if a woman makes a vow to the LORD, and binds herself by some agreement while in her father's house in her youth,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:4: Numbers 30:4 and her father hears her vow and the agreement by which she has bound herself, and her father holds his peace, then all her vows shall stand, and every agreement with which she has bound herself shall stand.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:5: Numbers 30:5 But if her father overrules her on the day that he hears, then none of her vows nor her agreements by which she has bound herself shall stand; and the LORD will release her, because her father overruled her.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:6: Numbers 30:6 "If indeed she takes a husband, while bound by her vows or by a rash utterance from her lips by which she bound herself,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:7: Numbers 30:7 and her husband hears it, and makes no response to her on the day that he hears, then her vows shall stand, and her agreements by which she bound herself shall stand.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:8: Numbers 30:8 But if her husband overrules her on the day that he hears it, he shall make void her vow which she took and what she uttered with her lips, by which she bound herself, and the LORD will release her.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:9: Numbers 30:9 "Also any vow of a widow or a divorced woman, by which she has bound herself, shall stand against her.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:10: Numbers 30:10 "If she vowed in her husband's house, or bound herself by an agreement with an oath,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:11: Numbers 30:11 and her husband heard it, and made no response to her and did not overrule her, then all her vows shall stand, and every agreement by which she bound herself shall stand.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:12: Numbers 30:12 But if her husband truly made them void on the day he heard them, then whatever proceeded from her lips concerning her vows or concerning the agreement binding her, it shall not stand; her husband has made them void, and the LORD will release her.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:13: Numbers 30:13 Every vow and every binding oath to afflict her soul, her husband may confirm it, or her husband may make it void.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:14: Numbers 30:14 Now if her husband makes no response whatever to her from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or all the agreements that bind her; he confirms them, because he made no response to her on the day that he heard them.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:15: Numbers 30:15 But if he does make them void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her guilt."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 30:16: Numbers 30:16 These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, and between a father and his daughter in her youth in her father's house.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:1: Numbers 31:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:2: Numbers 31:2 "Take vengeance on the Midianites for the children of Israel. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:3: Numbers 31:3 So Moses spoke to the people, saying, "Arm some of yourselves for war, and let them go against the Midianites to take vengeance for the LORD on Midian.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:4: Numbers 31:4 A thousand from each tribe of all the tribes of Israel you shall send to the war."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:5: Numbers 31:5 So there were recruited from the divisions of Israel one thousand from each tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:6: Numbers 31:6 Then Moses sent them to the war, one thousand from each tribe; he sent them to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, with the holy articles and the signal trumpets in his hand.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:7: Numbers 31:7 And they warred against the Midianites, just as the LORD commanded Moses, and they killed all the males.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:8: Numbers 31:8 They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of those who were killed"” Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. Balaam the son of Beor they also killed with the sword.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:9: Numbers 31:9 And the children of Israel took the women of Midian captive, with their little ones, and took as spoil all their cattle, all their flocks, and all their goods.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:10: Numbers 31:10 They also burned with fire all the cities where they dwelt, and all their forts.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:11: Numbers 31:11 And they took all the spoil and all the booty"”of man and beast.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:12: Numbers 31:12 Then they brought the captives, the booty, and the spoil to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:13: Numbers 31:13 And Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the congregation, went to meet them outside the camp.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:14: Numbers 31:14 But Moses was angry with the officers of the army, with the captains over thousands and captains over hundreds, who had come from the battle.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:15: Numbers 31:15 And Moses said to them: "Have you kept all the women alive?(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:16: Numbers 31:16 Look, these women caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to trespass against the LORD in the incident of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:17: Numbers 31:17 Now therefore, kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known a man intimately.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:18: Numbers 31:18 But keep alive for yourselves all the young girls who have not known a man intimately.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:19: Numbers 31:19 And as for you, remain outside the camp seven days; whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves and your captives on the third day and on the seventh day.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:20: Numbers 31:20 Purify every garment, everything made of leather, everything woven of goats' hair, and everything made of wood."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:21: Numbers 31:21 Then Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who had gone to the battle, "This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses:(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:22: Numbers 31:22 Only the gold, the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:23: Numbers 31:23 everything that can endure fire, you shall put through the fire, and it shall be clean; and it shall be purified with the water of purification. But all that cannot endure fire you shall put through water.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:24: Numbers 31:24 And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day and be clean, and afterward you may come into the camp."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:25: Numbers 31:25 Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:26: Numbers 31:26 "Count up the plunder that was taken"”of man and beast"”you and Eleazar the priest and the chief fathers of the congregation;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:27: Numbers 31:27 and divide the plunder into two parts, between those who took part in the war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:28: Numbers 31:28 And levy a tribute for the LORD on the men of war who went out to battle: one of every five hundred of the persons, the cattle, the donkeys, and the sheep;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:29: Numbers 31:29 take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest as a heave offering to the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:30: Numbers 31:30 And from the children of Israel's half you shall take one of every fifty, drawn from the persons, the cattle, the donkeys, and the sheep, from all the livestock, and give them to the Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle of the LORD."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:31: Numbers 31:31 So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:32: Numbers 31:32 The booty remaining from the plunder, which the men of war had taken, was six hundred and seventy-five thousand sheep,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:35: Numbers 31:35 and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of women who had not known a man intimately.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:36: Numbers 31:36 And the half, the portion for those who had gone out to war, was in number three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:37: Numbers 31:37 and the LORD's tribute of the sheep was six hundred and seventy-five.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:38: Numbers 31:38 The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which the LORD's tribute was seventy-two.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:39: Numbers 31:39 The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the LORD's tribute was sixty-one.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:40: Numbers 31:40 The persons were sixteen thousand, of which the LORD's tribute was thirty-two persons.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:41: Numbers 31:41 So Moses gave the tribute which was the LORD's heave offering to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:42: Numbers 31:42 And from the children of Israel's half, which Moses separated from the men who fought"”(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:43: Numbers 31:43 now the half belonging to the congregation was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:45: Numbers 31:45 thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:47: Numbers 31:47 and from the children of Israel's half Moses took one of every fifty, drawn from man and beast, and gave them to the Levites, who kept charge of the tabernacle of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:48: Numbers 31:48 Then the officers who were over thousands of the army, the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, came near to Moses;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:49: Numbers 31:49 and they said to Moses, "Your servants have taken a count of the men of war who are under our command, and not a man of us is missing.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:50: Numbers 31:50 Therefore we have brought an offering for the LORD, what every man found of ornaments of gold: armlets and bracelets and signet rings and earrings and necklaces, to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:51: Numbers 31:51 So Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from them, all the fashioned ornaments.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:52: Numbers 31:52 And all the gold of the offering that they offered to the LORD, from the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:53: Numbers 31:53 (The men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)(NKJV)
verses.numbers 31:54: Numbers 31:54 And Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of meeting as a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:1: Numbers 32:1 Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock; and when they saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, that indeed the region was a place for livestock,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:2: Numbers 32:2 the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the leaders of the congregation, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:3: Numbers 32:3 "Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Shebam, Nebo, and Beon,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:4: Numbers 32:4 the country which the LORD defeated before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock, and your servants have livestock."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:5: Numbers 32:5 Therefore they said, "If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants as a possession. Do not take us over the Jordan."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:6: Numbers 32:6 And Moses said to the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben: "Shall your brethren go to war while you sit here?(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:7: Numbers 32:7 Now why will you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them?(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:8: Numbers 32:8 Thus your fathers did when I sent them away from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:9: Numbers 32:9 For when they went up to the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, so that they did not go into the land which the LORD had given them.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:10: Numbers 32:10 So the LORD's anger was aroused on that day, and He swore an oath, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:11: Numbers 32:11 "˜Surely none of the men who came up from Egypt, from twenty years old and above, shall see the land of which I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, because they have not wholly followed Me,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:12: Numbers 32:12 except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, for they have wholly followed the LORD.'(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:13: Numbers 32:13 So the LORD's anger was aroused against Israel, and He made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation that had done evil in the sight of the LORD was gone.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:14: Numbers 32:14 And look! You have risen in your fathers' place, a brood of sinful men, to increase still more the fierce anger of the LORD against Israel.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:15: Numbers 32:15 For if you turn away from following Him, He will once again leave them in the wilderness, and you will destroy all these people."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:16: Numbers 32:16 Then they came near to him and said: "We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:17: Numbers 32:17 but we ourselves will be armed, ready to go before the children of Israel until we have brought them to their place; and our little ones will dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:18: Numbers 32:18 We will not return to our homes until every one of the children of Israel has received his inheritance.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:19: Numbers 32:19 For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has fallen to us on this eastern side of the Jordan."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:20: Numbers 32:20 Then Moses said to them: "If you do this thing, if you arm yourselves before the LORD for the war,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:21: Numbers 32:21 and all your armed men cross over the Jordan before the LORD until He has driven out His enemies from before Him,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:22: Numbers 32:22 and the land is subdued before the LORD, then afterward you may return and be blameless before the LORD and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:23: Numbers 32:23 But if you do not do so, then take note, you have sinned against the LORD; and be sure your sin will find you out.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:24: Numbers 32:24 Build cities for your little ones and folds for your sheep, and do what has proceeded out of your mouth."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:25: Numbers 32:25 And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying: "Your servants will do as my lord commands.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:26: Numbers 32:26 Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock will be there in the cities of Gilead;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:27: Numbers 32:27 but your servants will cross over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, just as my lord says."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:28: Numbers 32:28 So Moses gave command concerning them to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:29: Numbers 32:29 And Moses said to them: "If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben cross over the Jordan with you, every man armed for battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead as a possession.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:30: Numbers 32:30 But if they do not cross over armed with you, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:31: Numbers 32:31 Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying: "As the LORD has said to your servants, so we will do.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:32: Numbers 32:32 We will cross over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, but the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us on this side of the Jordan."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:33: Numbers 32:33 So Moses gave to the children of Gad, to the children of Reuben, and to half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land with its cities within the borders, the cities of the surrounding country.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:34: Numbers 32:34 And the children of Gad built Dibon and Ataroth and Aroer,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:35: Numbers 32:35 Atroth and Shophan and Jazer and Jogbehah,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:36: Numbers 32:36 Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran, fortified cities, and folds for sheep.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:37: Numbers 32:37 And the children of Reuben built Heshbon and Elealeh and Kirjathaim,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:38: Numbers 32:38 Nebo and Baal Meon (their names being changed) and Shibmah; and they gave other names to the cities which they built.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:39: Numbers 32:39 And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead and took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were in it.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:40: Numbers 32:40 So Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh, and he dwelt in it.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:41: Numbers 32:41 Also Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its small towns, and called them Havoth Jair.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 32:42: Numbers 32:42 Then Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and he called it Nobah, after his own name.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:1: Numbers 33:1 These are the journeys of the children of Israel, who went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:2: Numbers 33:2 Now Moses wrote down the starting points of their journeys at the command of the LORD. And these are their journeys according to their starting points:(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:3: Numbers 33:3 They departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the day after the Passover the children of Israel went out with boldness in the sight of all the Egyptians.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:4: Numbers 33:4 For the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had killed among them. Also on their gods the LORD had executed judgments.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:5: Numbers 33:5 Then the children of Israel moved from Rameses and camped at Succoth.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:6: Numbers 33:6 They departed from Succoth and camped at Etham, which is on the edge of the wilderness.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:7: Numbers 33:7 They moved from Etham and turned back to Pi Hahiroth, which is east of Baal Zephon; and they camped near Migdol.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:8: Numbers 33:8 They departed from before Hahiroth and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, went three days' journey in the Wilderness of Etham, and camped at Marah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:9: Numbers 33:9 They moved from Marah and came to Elim. At Elim were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees; so they camped there.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:10: Numbers 33:10 They moved from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:11: Numbers 33:11 They moved from the Red Sea and camped in the Wilderness of Sin.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:12: Numbers 33:12 They journeyed from the Wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:13: Numbers 33:13 They departed from Dophkah and camped at Alush.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:14: Numbers 33:14 They moved from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:15: Numbers 33:15 They departed from Rephidim and camped in the Wilderness of Sinai.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:16: Numbers 33:16 They moved from the Wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth Hattaavah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:17: Numbers 33:17 They departed from Kibroth Hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:18: Numbers 33:18 They departed from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:19: Numbers 33:19 They departed from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon Perez.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:20: Numbers 33:20 They departed from Rimmon Perez and camped at Libnah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:21: Numbers 33:21 They moved from Libnah and camped at Rissah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:22: Numbers 33:22 They journeyed from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:23: Numbers 33:23 They went from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:24: Numbers 33:24 They moved from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:25: Numbers 33:25 They moved from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:26: Numbers 33:26 They moved from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:27: Numbers 33:27 They departed from Tahath and camped at Terah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:28: Numbers 33:28 They moved from Terah and camped at Mithkah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:29: Numbers 33:29 They went from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:30: Numbers 33:30 They departed from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:31: Numbers 33:31 They departed from Moseroth and camped at Bene Jaakan.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:32: Numbers 33:32 They moved from Bene Jaakan and camped at Hor Hagidgad.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:33: Numbers 33:33 They went from Hor Hagidgad and camped at Jotbathah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:34: Numbers 33:34 They moved from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:35: Numbers 33:35 They departed from Abronah and camped at Ezion Geber.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:36: Numbers 33:36 They moved from Ezion Geber and camped in the Wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:37: Numbers 33:37 They moved from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the boundary of the land of Edom.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:38: Numbers 33:38 Then Aaron the priest went up to Mount Hor at the command of the LORD, and died there in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, on the first day of the fifth month.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:39: Numbers 33:39 Aaron was one hundred and twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:40: Numbers 33:40 Now the king of Arad, the Canaanite, who dwelt in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:41: Numbers 33:41 So they departed from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:42: Numbers 33:42 They departed from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:43: Numbers 33:43 They departed from Punon and camped at Oboth.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:44: Numbers 33:44 They departed from Oboth and camped at Ije Abarim, at the border of Moab.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:45: Numbers 33:45 They departed from Ijim and camped at Dibon Gad.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:46: Numbers 33:46 They moved from Dibon Gad and camped at Almon Diblathaim.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:47: Numbers 33:47 They moved from Almon Diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:48: Numbers 33:48 They departed from the mountains of Abarim and camped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:49: Numbers 33:49 They camped by the Jordan, from Beth Jesimoth as far as the Abel Acacia Grove in the plains of Moab.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:50: Numbers 33:50 Now the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:51: Numbers 33:51 "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: "˜When you have crossed the Jordan into the land of Canaan,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:52: Numbers 33:52 then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their engraved stones, destroy all their molded images, and demolish all their high places;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:53: Numbers 33:53 you shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land and dwell in it, for I have given you the land to possess.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:54: Numbers 33:54 And you shall divide the land by lot as an inheritance among your families; to the larger you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance; there everyone's inheritance shall be whatever falls to him by lot. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:55: Numbers 33:55 But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then it shall be that those whom you let remain shall be irritants in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and they shall harass you in the land where you dwell.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 33:56: Numbers 33:56 Moreover it shall be that I will do to you as I thought to do to them.' "(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:1: Numbers 34:1 Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:2: Numbers 34:2 "Command the children of Israel, and say to them: "˜When you come into the land of Canaan, this is the land that shall fall to you as an inheritance"”the land of Canaan to its boundaries.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:3: Numbers 34:3 Your southern border shall be from the Wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom; then your southern border shall extend eastward to the end of the Salt Sea;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:4: Numbers 34:4 your border shall turn from the southern side of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continue to Zin, and be on the south of Kadesh Barnea; then it shall go on to Hazar Addar, and continue to Azmon;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:5: Numbers 34:5 the border shall turn from Azmon to the Brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the Sea.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:6: Numbers 34:6 "˜As for the western border, you shall have the Great Sea for a border; this shall be your western border.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:7: Numbers 34:7 "˜And this shall be your northern border: From the Great Sea you shall mark out your border line to Mount Hor;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:8: Numbers 34:8 from Mount Hor you shall mark out your border to the entrance of Hamath; then the direction of the border shall be toward Zedad;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:9: Numbers 34:9 the border shall proceed to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your northern border.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:10: Numbers 34:10 "˜You shall mark out your eastern border from Hazar Enan to Shepham;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:11: Numbers 34:11 the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain; the border shall go down and reach to the eastern side of the Sea of Chinnereth;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:12: Numbers 34:12 the border shall go down along the Jordan, and it shall end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land with its surrounding boundaries.' "(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:13: Numbers 34:13 Then Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying: "This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes and to the half-tribe.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:14: Numbers 34:14 For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and the half-tribe of Manasseh has received its inheritance.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:15: Numbers 34:15 The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance on this side of the Jordan, across from Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:16: Numbers 34:16 And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:17: Numbers 34:17 "These are the names of the men who shall divide the land among you as an inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:18: Numbers 34:18 And you shall take one leader of every tribe to divide the land for the inheritance.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:19: Numbers 34:19 These are the names of the men: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:20: Numbers 34:20 from the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:21: Numbers 34:21 from the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:22: Numbers 34:22 a leader from the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:23: Numbers 34:23 from the sons of Joseph: a leader from the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:24: Numbers 34:24 and a leader from the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:25: Numbers 34:25 a leader from the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:26: Numbers 34:26 a leader from the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:27: Numbers 34:27 a leader from the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:28: Numbers 34:28 and a leader from the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 34:29: Numbers 34:29 These are the ones the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance among the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:1: Numbers 35:1 And the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, saying:(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:2: Numbers 35:2 "Command the children of Israel that they give the Levites cities to dwell in from the inheritance of their possession, and you shall also give the Levites common-land around the cities.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:3: Numbers 35:3 They shall have the cities to dwell in; and their common-land shall be for their cattle, for their herds, and for all their animals.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:4: Numbers 35:4 The common-land of the cities which you will give the Levites shall extend from the wall of the city outward a thousand cubits all around.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:5: Numbers 35:5 And you shall measure outside the city on the east side two thousand cubits, on the south side two thousand cubits, on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits. The city shall be in the middle. This shall belong to them as common-land for the cities.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:6: Numbers 35:6 "Now among the cities which you will give to the Levites you shall appoint six cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee. And to these you shall add forty-two cities.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:7: Numbers 35:7 So all the cities you will give to the Levites shall be forty-eight; these you shall give with their common-land.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:8: Numbers 35:8 And the cities which you will give shall be from the possession of the children of Israel; from the larger tribe you shall give many, from the smaller you shall give few. Each shall give some of its cities to the Levites, in proportion to the inheritance that each receives."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:9: Numbers 35:9 Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:10: Numbers 35:10 "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: "˜When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:11: Numbers 35:11 then you shall appoint cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the manslayer who kills any person accidentally may flee there.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:12: Numbers 35:12 They shall be cities of refuge for you from the avenger, that the manslayer may not die until he stands before the congregation in judgment.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:13: Numbers 35:13 And of the cities which you give, you shall have six cities of refuge.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:14: Numbers 35:14 You shall appoint three cities on this side of the Jordan, and three cities you shall appoint in the land of Canaan, which will be cities of refuge.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:15: Numbers 35:15 These six cities shall be for refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them, that anyone who kills a person accidentally may flee there.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:16: Numbers 35:16 "˜But if he strikes him with an iron implement, so that he dies, he is a murderer; the murderer shall surely be put to death.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:17: Numbers 35:17 And if he strikes him with a stone in the hand, by which one could die, and he does die, he is a murderer; the murderer shall surely be put to death.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:18: Numbers 35:18 Or if he strikes him with a wooden hand weapon, by which one could die, and he does die, he is a murderer; the murderer shall surely be put to death.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:19: Numbers 35:19 The avenger of blood himself shall put the murderer to death; when he meets him, he shall put him to death.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:20: Numbers 35:20 If he pushes him out of hatred or, while lying in wait, hurls something at him so that he dies,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:21: Numbers 35:21 or in enmity he strikes him with his hand so that he dies, the one who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:22: Numbers 35:22 "˜However, if he pushes him suddenly without enmity, or throws anything at him without lying in wait,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:23: Numbers 35:23 or uses a stone, by which a man could die, throwing it at him without seeing him, so that he dies, while he was not his enemy or seeking his harm,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:24: Numbers 35:24 then the congregation shall judge between the manslayer and the avenger of blood according to these judgments.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:25: Numbers 35:25 So the congregation shall deliver the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall return him to the city of refuge where he had fled, and he shall remain there until the death of the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:26: Numbers 35:26 But if the manslayer at any time goes outside the limits of the city of refuge where he fled,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:27: Numbers 35:27 and the avenger of blood finds him outside the limits of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the manslayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:28: Numbers 35:28 because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest the manslayer may return to the land of his possession.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:29: Numbers 35:29 "˜And these things shall be a statute of judgment to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:30: Numbers 35:30 Whoever kills a person, the murderer shall be put to death on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness is not sufficient testimony against a person for the death penalty.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:31: Numbers 35:31 Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death, but he shall surely be put to death.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:32: Numbers 35:32 And you shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may return to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:33: Numbers 35:33 So you shall not pollute the land where you are; for blood defiles the land, and no atonement can be made for the land, for the blood that is shed on it, except by the blood of him who shed it.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 35:34: Numbers 35:34 Therefore do not defile the land which you inhabit, in the midst of which I dwell; for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.' "(NKJV)
verses.numbers 36:1: Numbers 36:1 Now the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the leaders, the chief fathers of the children of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 36:2: Numbers 36:2 And they said: "The LORD commanded my lord Moses to give the land as an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel, and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 36:3: Numbers 36:3 Now if they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and it will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry; so it will be taken from the lot of our inheritance.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 36:4: Numbers 36:4 And when the Jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry; so their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 36:5: Numbers 36:5 Then Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying: "What the tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks is right.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 36:6: Numbers 36:6 This is what the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, "˜Let them marry whom they think best, but they may marry only within the family of their father's tribe.'(NKJV)
verses.numbers 36:7: Numbers 36:7 So the inheritance of the children of Israel shall not change hands from tribe to tribe, for every one of the children of Israel shall keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 36:8: Numbers 36:8 And every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be the wife of one of the family of her father's tribe, so that the children of Israel each may possess the inheritance of his fathers.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 36:9: Numbers 36:9 Thus no inheritance shall change hands from one tribe to another, but every tribe of the children of Israel shall keep its own inheritance."(NKJV)
verses.numbers 36:10: Numbers 36:10 Just as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad;(NKJV)
verses.numbers 36:11: Numbers 36:11 for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to the sons of their father's brothers.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 36:12: Numbers 36:12 They were married into the families of the children of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of their father's family.(NKJV)
verses.numbers 36:13: Numbers 36:13 These are the commandments and the judgments which the LORD commanded the children of Israel by the hand of Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho.(NKJV)
